# Operations and wire map

Generated from explicit server registration, desktop queue calls and phone projection inventories. Display projection does not authorize a write.

| Operation | Server handler | Desktop queue method | Phone behavior |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `add_goal` | [add_goal](../../server/operations/goals.py) | `add_todo_task` | Tracking display projection |
| `add_milestone` | [add_milestone](../../server/operations/milestones.py) | `add_milestone` | Tracking display projection |
| `add_session` | [add_session](../../server/operations/sessions.py) | `add_session` | Server authority: Persisted sessions and day totals wait for server validation and logical-day attribution. |
| `add_subject` | [add_subject](../../server/operations/subjects.py) | `add_subject` | Tracking display projection |
| `add_template` | [add_template](../../server/operations/templates.py) | `add_goal_template` | Tracking display projection |
| `archive_subject` | [archive_subject](../../server/operations/subjects.py) | `archive_subject` | Tracking display projection |
| `complete_goal` | [complete_goal](../../server/operations/goals.py) | `complete_goal` | Tracking display projection |
| `delete_goal` | [delete_goal](../../server/operations/goals.py) | `delete_todo_task` | Tracking display projection |
| `delete_milestone` | [delete_milestone](../../server/operations/milestones.py) | `delete_milestone` | Tracking display projection |
| `delete_session` | [delete_session](../../server/operations/sessions.py) | `delete_session` | Server authority: Day lists reload after the server acknowledges deletion. |
| `delete_subject` | [delete_subject](../../server/operations/subjects.py) | `delete_subject` | Server authority: Server owns cascading session deletion; the phone offers archive instead. |
| `delete_template` | [delete_template](../../server/operations/templates.py) | `delete_goal_template` | Tracking display projection |
| `delete_weight` | [delete_weight](../../server/operations/weight.py) | `delete_weight` | Weight display projection |
| `duplicate_session` | [duplicate_session](../../server/operations/sessions.py) |  | Server authority: Server chooses the destination logical day and validates the copy. |
| `generate_due_goals` | [generate_due_goals](../../server/operations/templates.py) | `generate_due_goal_instances` | Server authority: Server owns recurrence scheduling and occurrence identity. |
| `heartbeat` | [heartbeat](../../server/operations/timer.py) |  | Server authority: Heartbeat metadata does not change the displayed timer. |
| `import_backup` | [import_backup](../../server/operations/backup.py) | `import_data` | Server authority: Server owns restore, UID merging and authoritative replacement. |
| `import_weights` | [import_weights](../../server/operations/weight.py) |  | Server authority: Bulk import is an external adapter; the phone fetches the resulting history. |
| `resolve_recovery` | [resolve_recovery](../../server/operations/timer.py) | `__init__`, `resolve_recovery` | Server authority: Recovery is a desktop/server interaction; queued stops use exact timer identity. |
| `set_goal_order` | [set_goal_order](../../server/operations/goals.py) | `set_todo_task_order` | Tracking display projection |
| `set_milestone_done` | [set_milestone_done](../../server/operations/milestones.py) | `set_milestone_done` | Tracking display projection |
| `set_milestone_order` | [set_milestone_order](../../server/operations/milestones.py) | `set_milestone_order` | Server authority: The phone has no milestone ordering controls. |
| `set_setting` | [set_setting](../../server/operations/settings.py) | `set_day_start`, `set_setting` | Server authority: Logical-day changes wait for the shared server context. |
| `set_subject_order` | [set_subject_order](../../server/operations/subjects.py) | `set_subject_order` | Tracking display projection |
| `set_template_active` | [set_template_active](../../server/operations/templates.py) | `set_goal_template_active` | Tracking display projection |
| `shift_session` | [shift_session](../../server/operations/sessions.py) |  | Server authority: Server validates shifted timestamps and recalculates duration. |
